info.title: ARIN RDAP
info.description: Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP) service for American Registry for Internet Numbers (ARIN) -- the IETF-standardized (RFC 7480+) successor to legacy WHOIS, used to look up IP network, ASN, and organization/contact registration data. Public read-only service; no authentication required.
info.x-itential-curated: Reviewed against the repo's common-CRUD-for-automation policy: covers every get-by-identifier and search operation ARIN's RDAP service implements (domain search returns 501 Not Implemented on ARIN's server and is excluded). No larger vendor spec exists to trim from -- RDAP is an IETF standard with a fixed, small object model, not a large proprietary API surface.

get.description: Returns the network registration that contains the given IPv4 or IPv6 address.

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, e.g. 192.149.252.75.

get.description: Returns the network registration for the given CIDR block.
Returns the Autonomous System Number registration for the given ASN.

parameters.name: asnNumber
parameters.description: The ASN as a plain number (no AS prefix), e.g. 63218.

get.description: Returns an organization, point of contact, or customer record by its ARIN handle. RDAP unifies orgs, POCs, and customers into a single entity object distinguished by roles.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The entity's ARIN handle, e.g. ARIN or ARIN-HOSTMASTER.

get.description: Returns the reverse DNS delegation (nameservers and DNSSEC records) for the given in-addr.arpa or ip6.arpa zone.
Searches organizations, points of contact, and customers by name. Supports trailing wildcard (*).

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: Full or partial entity name, e.g. "ARIN*".

get.description: Searches Autonomous System Number registrations by name. Supports trailing wildcard (*).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Full or partial ASN name, e.g. "ARIN*".
